title: Teams desktop closes with an error on one clinic laptop; browser works
scenario: A single clinic user cannot start the Teams desktop client while colleagues and the browser version are fine. The first engineer reply demands traces from a non-technical user; a later simple cache deletion fixes the laptop.

events.title: Teams refuses to open on my work laptop
events.text: Good afternoon, my name is Beatriz Alves, dental nurse at the Kestrel Dental Group clinic in Porto. Since Monday my Teams on my work laptop will not start - a white window, then a message with caa82ee2 and then it closes by itself. Nobody else here has this, I asked Rui and Joana. I can open Teams in Edge and it works OK there. Please help me, I need Teams for the patient reminders.

events.title: Re: Teams will not start on my laptop
events.text:
Dear Beatriz, to analyse the issue properly I need a full network capture. Please install Fiddler Classic, enable HTTPS decryption, reproduce the failing start-up while capturing, save the session as a SAZ file, and also export a HAR file from the Edge developer tools for the sign-in that works, for comparison. Please send both files, and the Teams log bundle zipped (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+1 inside the app).

Kind regards, Dominic

events.title: Re: Teams will not start on my laptop
events.text: Dear Dominic, I tried but Fiddler asks for an administrator password and I do not have one, I am very sorry. Rui says maybe I should just delete the Teams folder and start again? Should I?

events.title: A much simpler step
events.text:
No need to apologise, forget the capture. Let's try something much simpler. Close Teams completely (right-click the icon in the tray, Quit), then empty out the Teams cache folder (%appdata%\Microsoft\Teams for the classic client, or %localappdata%\Packages\MSTeams_8wekyb3d8bbwe\LocalCache for the new one) and start Teams again.

Dominic

events.title: Re: A much simpler step
events.text: I deleted the folder as you wrote. Teams opened, asked for my password once and I am in. All my chats are there. It has been two hours and it is still working.

events.title: Re: A much simpler step
events.text:
Excellent. If it should come back we would look at a reinstall next, otherwise nothing more is needed. I will leave the case open until Friday and write to you then.

Dominic

events.title: Re: A much simpler step
events.text: Teams has worked every day since I deleted the folder. Thank you for your patience, and sorry about the Fiddler.
